site.faq.a1: Yes. A PC running Windows 10/11 is enough: download the app, Next → Next → Done, then connect the cameras in the browser. If your NVR is already on the network, the whole process usually takes up to 30 minutes. If the NVR needs setting up too — 45–90 minutes with a technician. Step-by-step guide.
site.faq.a2: Leave your number — we will suggest an option for your case: adapt what you have or install a ready device.
site.faq.a3: Usually not. If your camera or NVR provides an RTSP stream on the local network, the system works with it. Tested devices: Hikvision, HiLook, Dahua and Uniview NVRs. Other brands may work too — we check for free before connecting.
site.faq.a4: The full video archive stays on your own NVR or PC. Only event statistics and short clips are sent to the cloud, encrypted.
site.faq.a5: One till and one entrance — Starter is enough: you see how many people came in and out. Need queues, security and the shop map — Business. More than two shops — ask about Network. You can change plans later.
site.faq.a6: Right now you receive an invoice and an operator confirms the payment. Cash or bank transfer. No long-term contract. Once online providers are connected, the panel shows only the working method. Full refund within 14 days of the first payment — terms in the public offer.

site.hamkorlik.how_text: 1. Register in the partner panel; we approve you. 2. Tell us about your customer — we open the site and issue a pairing code. 3. Install the app on the shop's Windows PC and connect with the code. 4. Set up cameras and lines in the panel. Usually 45–90 minutes: less if the NVR is ready, more if RTSP and the network need work.
site.hamkorlik.need_text: A Windows 10/11 PC in the shop (an ordinary office PC is enough), an NVR or IP cameras (Hikvision, Dahua and others — ONVIF/RTSP), internet. Technical guides are ready; if something goes wrong you talk to us directly.
site.hamkorlik.offer_text: You install cameras and NVRs in shops — we make those cameras smart: entry and exit counting, queue monitoring, security alerts, Telegram reports. Extra value for your customer, extra income for you.
site.hamkorlik.title: Partnership (for installers) — ENES Monitoring
